title: Surgical Scars
text: Father explained to Elephant the situation with Big Sister, and laid out his plan to gather up the enslaved people on Éclair’s territory and rescue them by running his circus operation as a cover for slave trading, I say.
“Understood. I am Elmelo Puhanto, a knight who travels through various countries to broaden her knowledge. I look forward to working with you.”
Elephant struck a Siltvelt-style pose of loyalty, indeed. Oh, how splendid—Elephant was fired up and ready to go. Since Elephant was a good elephant, I decided to cheer her on.
“Now then, this person here is…”
“Right. This is Motoyasu-kun, the Spear Hero. He’s a bit clumsy in some ways, but were you all right with him, Elmelo-san?”
“Yes. I was interested in the details of the job I was asked to do, so I came along, and I intend to see it through no matter what happens.”
“What exactly were you asked to do?”
“I was asked to provide escort duty and look after these children.”
“Piyo!”
Yuki-chan and the others cheerfully chimed in to make their presence known.
“I see, so you’re skilled at taking care of Filolials.”
“Um…”
Ah, so Elephant was curious about Father too, was she. Fear not, I say.
“Of course you’ll be escorting Father as well, indeed. Given that you’ve traveled to so many different countries, I imagine even just conversing with you would prove quite educational.”
“Right, nice to meet you. And if you’re also good in a fight… would you be willing to help train the other slaves I’m looking after, aside from Motoyasu-kun?”
“Yes.”
Elephant’s enthusiasm knew no bounds, it seemed. Well, naturally—Elephant was practically an upgraded version of Éclair, an all-purpose elephant capable of even managing territory administration.
“Well then, looking forward to working with you.”

And so, Elephant became a member of the circus troupe as well. In shows with Filolial-sama, Elephant would dress up and assist in Filolial-sama’s elegant dancing, indeed. Incidentally, after finishing the conversation, Elephant combed her own ears like hair and murmured quietly, “Lars, you really made the wrong career choice…” expressing what seemed to be sympathy toward Panda for some reason. Fear not, I say. Father will bring Panda along eventually.
“Bow-wow!”
Wolf called out from a distance, asking Father if he was ready yet.
“Ah, Wolf. All right, all right, just wait a bit.”
“…That slave truly seems to have taken to you on pure instinct.”
“He’s honest and sweet. At first I thought he was pretty rough around the edges, but… I hope his reason comes back to him eventually.”
Father offered his thoughts in response to the Siltvelt envoy’s words. Right, Wolf was dominated by instinct, after all.
“That slave…”
Elephant narrowed her eyes here.
“Come to think of it, aren’t you a famous fighter in the Zeltoble colosseum, Elephant? Do you know anything about him?”
“No… though I feel like I may have seen him somewhere before…”
“Apparently he originally lost some important match in the arena and ended up with a huge debt—does that ring any bells?”
“The Zeltoble Colosseum can be quite merciless in such matters, so prying into an opponent’s circumstances is taboo. But… I’m sorry. I can’t recall anything.”
“No, it’s fine. I just hope he can get his instincts under control eventually.”
It seemed Wolf had left an impression on quite a few people, one way or another.
“The sun’s starting to set, so let’s all eat and get some energy for tomorrow!”
“Yeah!”
“Wooof!”
And so, once again tonight, everyone got to enjoy Father’s cooking together.
“Piyo-piyo!”

Yuki-chan and the others ate cheerfully and then took their afternoon nap. After the meal, Father tended to the slaves entrusted to his care. Apparently, thanks to the massages, Rabbit Guy’s arm joints had become considerably more mobile. The mixed-breed lizardman seemed to be lost in thought about something. Meanwhile, I was busy introducing Elephant to Filolial-sama and the others. And tonight, it was time to train Yuki-chan and the rest—off to earn some money in the dead of night!
Before setting out, though. Inside the makeshift tent, partitioned off into sections, I made my way over to where Father was. The Siltvelt envoy was standing by as well.
“Kuuu…”
There, I found Wolf, having been thoroughly brushed by Father, apparently fast asleep.
“Ah, Motoyasu-kun. What’s up?”
“Off to level up Yuki-chan and the others, I say.”
Even with Elephant present, I was still a bit uneasy about leaving command of Filolial-sama and the rest in her hands alone, indeed.
“Also, I’m here to send Father off to Big Sister’s place.”
Since Father was worried about how Big Sister was doing, he was to head to Zeltoble that night to see her and the others.
“Ah… right, that’s right. And speaking of which… I finally figured out something that’s been bothering me about Wolf.”

Apparently, even though Wolf had taken a liking to him, there had always been some distance between them, and he’d never slept this soundly before. Father, while brushing Wolf’s fur, gently—carefully—parted it to reveal what lay beneath. And there, scattered across his body, were countless scars that looked like bullet wounds.
“Those aren’t the kind of scars you see very often.”
“Yeah. These look like they were made by a gun, but… could it be magic or something?”
“Hard to say for certain. I’ve heard that some rather unusual duels take place in the Zeltoble Colosseum.”
“And then… here, and here too.”

Father rolled Wolf over and parted the fur on his belly. There, they found what looked like surgical scars—as if his stomach had been cut open and stitched back up. Parting the fur at the back of his head revealed similar marks as well.

“There are marks like his stomach was opened up, and even his head was tampered with somehow… Wolf really does have some strange scars on him. It’s less like he’s just dominated by instinct and more like… I’m starting to worry he might’ve been through some kind of human experimentation.”
“This one is quite a troubled slave indeed.”
“As for the injuries that are tough to treat with just limb therapy, hopefully your healing magic or some medicine can help things along, Motoyasu-kun.”
“You should practice and learn some magic yourself too, Father, I say.”
After all, Father’s expertise in that area far surpassed mine. That said, dealing in medicine again would risk repeating past troubles, so we decided against that route.
“Yeah. I’ll do my best.”
“…Kuuun.”
Perhaps dreaming about something, Wolf gently kicked his limbs about, looking rather pleased with himself. So as not to wake him, Father quietly draped a blanket over him and stood up.
“Well, let’s get going then.”
“Righto, I say!”

Father was kept incredibly busy—managing the slaves while also caring for Big Sister and the others. And so, I swiftly sent Father off to Zeltoble. We parted ways in front of the treatment facility where Big Sister and the others were staying, each heading off to our own tasks.
Straight into the mountains at full speed! Now then, time for some fun hunting!

“Aiming Lancer, times ten! Brionac, times ten! Gungnir, times ten! Liberation Fireheal— no wait, Liberation Firestorm, times ten! Liberation Prominence, times ten! Hahaha! Weak! You’re all far too weak!”
Our usual routine of leveling up deep in the mountains, hunting dragons and griffins as customary, indeed!
“Gyaaaaah!?”
I harvested them thoroughly, turning them all into experience points for Yuki-chan and the other Filolial-sama! The monsters’ screams echoed through the mountains.
“Piyoooo!”

Yuki-chan and the others perched cheerfully on my shoulders, calling out with delight. What a fun time it was, indeed. The drops I gathered went straight toward funding Big Sister’s hospital fees and covering Elephant’s employment costs.
